title: Đường Đua Sinh Tử: 10 Giây Tự Do

vehicles.RIG_18: Massive 18-wheel charcoal highway semi-truck and sealed silver cargo trailer hauling high-value electronics crates.
vehicles.CIVIC_TRIO: Three matte-black lowered sport coupes with glowing green LED underglow, sunroof hatch and reinforced front hood latches.
vehicles.ECLIPSE: Neon-green tuned sport coupe with carbon hood, silver sport graphics, dual NOS bottles in the rear mount and telemetry laptop on the dash.
vehicles.RX7: Deep-red rotary sport coupe with sleek aerodynamic body, silver twin-spoke rims and cockpit boost gauges.
vehicles.CHARGER: Classic 1970 matte-black muscle car with a towering chrome supercharger blower rising through the hood.
vehicles.SUPRA_SHELL: Rusted, dented orange sport coupe rolling shell on a flatbed tow truck before rebuild, carrying an intact twin-turbo engine block under the hood.
vehicles.SUPRA: Rebuilt 10-second bright metallic-orange twin-turbo sport coupe with removable targa roof and high rear wing.
vehicles.JETTA: Prized alpine-white tuned sport sedan with white alloy rims and custom dashboard telemetry display.
vehicles.S2000: Jet-black open-top roadster with concealed dual Nitrous Oxide system under the driver seat.
vehicles.MOTO_PACK: Matte-black high-displacement street sport motorcycles with carbon-textured fairings.
vehicles.F150_TRUCK: Bright-red shop pickup truck carrying wooden auto-parts crates in the rear bed.

objects.TUNA_SANDWICH: White ceramic plate holding a crustless tuna sandwich and a tall glass of iced water on the Toto counter.

objects.NOS_BOTTLES: Twin blue high-pressure Nitrous Oxide cylinders mounted behind the cockpit with a red steering-wheel trigger button.
objects.DIAG_LAPTOP: Ruggedized silver tuning laptop displaying engine manifold pressure curves and overload warnings without readable text.
objects.CASE_FILES: Thick manila highway transport investigation folders, satellite route maps and customs manifests without readable text.
objects.WRENCH_KIT: Heavy chrome torque wrench, socket tray and engine hoist chains inside the garage.

objects.CUSTOMS_INVOICE: Stamped customs clearance ledger and legal import manifests inside Ny Tran's bonded warehouse.

narrator.voice: Narrator: an outside storyteller who is NOT a character in the film: one consistent mature Southern Vietnamese woman's voice, calm, low and warm, speaking about the person in the third person, used only to introduce a lead at first appearance. Every mouth in frame stays closed while she speaks; never lip-sync her words to anyone on screen.
narrator.voice_vi: Nữ khoảng năm mươi tuổi, giọng Nam Bộ (Sài Gòn); tông trầm ấm (alto), hơi khàn nhẹ; giọng kể điềm tĩnh, sâu lắng như người dẫn phim điện ảnh, nhịp chậm đều, khoảng ba rưỡi âm tiết mỗi giây. Không phải nhân vật trong cảnh: mọi miệng trên hình khép, không ai nhép theo lời bà.

HIGHWAY_NIGHT: Interstate 10 highway at night: four wide asphalt lanes cutting through dark desert hills, amber reflector studs along the divider, long headlight beams slicing the dark, no readable road signs.
deep diesel rig rumble, high-rpm tuned exhausts and highway wind
RIG_CABIN: Interior of the 18-wheel semi-truck cab at night: high leather driver seat on the left, large steering wheel, amber dashboard gauges, wide side mirrors reflecting green underglow behind, passenger window on the right.
diesel cabin vibration, air-horn valve and wind rushing past glass
VERS_GARAGE: The Ver's Geh auto parts and tuning shop in Los Angeles: high corrugated roof, hydraulic car lifts, tool chests, racks of chrome intakes and turbochargers, sunny roll-up bay door opening to the street, no readable brand logos.
air wrench whir, metal tools clinking and distant city traffic
TOTO_DINER: Toto family grocery and sandwich counter at midday: sunlit front windows, long wooden lunch counter with chrome stools, glass display shelves, kitchen pass-through behind the counter, no readable signs.
ceiling fan hum, plates clinking and midday street traffic outside
TOTO_PATIO: Sunlit concrete patio outside Toto grocery: wooden lunch tables under a canvas awning, kerbside parking along the palm-lined Los Angeles street, red pickup and lowered street cars parked at the kerb.
street breeze, shoes scuffling on concrete and idling engines
TASKFORCE_HQ: Abandoned hillside Spanish-style villa converted into a covert LAPD-FBI task-force operations room: tall arched windows with slatted blinds, tactical tables, highway route maps and pinboards with vehicle photos, no readable text.
air-conditioner hum, footsteps on tile and rustling case folders
RACE_MEET: South Los Angeles industrial warehouse district at night: wide asphalt avenue between concrete warehouses, hundreds of colorful tuned street cars parked under sodium floodlights, tire smoke drifting, no readable banners.
thumping bass, revving tuned engines and cheering street crowd
RACE_COCKPIT: Interior cockpit of the tuned street race coupe at night: bucket seats, leather steering wheel with red NOS thumb button, glowing dashboard tachometers, passenger-side telemetry laptop screen, sodium streetlights streaking past the windshield.
screaming twin-cam engine, turbocharger whistle and gear shifts
RACE_ALLEY: Narrow industrial back alley behind the South L.A. warehouses at night: brick walls, stacked wooden pallets, chain-link fences, red-and-blue patrol lights reflecting off wet asphalt at both ends.
distant police sirens, echoing footsteps and skidding tires
SAIGON_LOT: Desolate gravel lot at the edge of Little Saigon at night: rusted shipping containers, chain-link perimeter fence, neon shop glow far behind, circle of matte-black sport motorcycles surrounding the parked coupe.
idling sport-bike engines, gravel crunching and night wind
TOTO_BACKYARD: Backyard of the Toto family house in Echo Park at dusk and night: string lights over a long wooden dining table, smoking charcoal barbecue grill, lawn edged with wooden fencing, open driveway leading to the home garage.
charcoal grill sizzle, clinking bottles and warm evening crickets
TOTO_GARAGE: Detached two-bay garage behind the Toto house: warm overhead work lamps, engine hoist, workbenches stacked with wrenches and manifolds, concrete floor, rear corner holding the covered 1970 muscle car.
ratchet wrenches turning, chain hoist clinking and fluorescent hum
NYTRAN_MANSION: Courtyard and living hall of Ny Tran's gated Little Saigon residence at dawn: wrought-iron front gates, stone driveway, modern living room with leather sofas and silk wall panels.
tactical boots on stone, helicopter blades high overhead and rustling papers
NYTRAN_WAREHOUSE: Large customs-bonded electronics warehouse behind Ny Tran's compound: tall steel shelving stacked with sealed brown cartons, forklift aisle, inspection desk with stamped shipping ledgers, high skylight windows.
echoing footsteps on concrete and flipping ledger pages
RACE_WARS: Mojave Desert Race Wars airfield under blazing midday sun: vast heat-shimmering concrete runway, canopies and pit tents lined with tuned cars, desert mountains on the horizon, two-lane drag strip with starting lights.
roaring engines, desert wind and crowd murmur across the tarmac
DESERT_HIGHWAY: Two-lane desert highway cutting across arid scrubland under late-afternoon sun: long straight asphalt, sandy shoulders, heat haze rising in the distance, no readable highway signs.
heavy diesel engine, high-speed wind and tires roaring on hot asphalt
TOTO_FRONT: Tree-lined residential street in front of the Toto family white clapboard house at golden-hour sunset: front lawn, concrete porch steps, driveway leading back to the garage.
evening breeze through palm fronds and approaching engines
LA_HILLS_ROAD: Steep, sloping asphalt avenues in the Los Angeles hills at sunset: palm trees, concrete retaining walls, long downhill intersections overlooking the city basin, concrete storm-drain channel below the lower curve.
supercharger whine, screaming tires and roaring exhausts
RAIL_CROSSING: Outskirts industrial railroad crossing at sunset: two-lane road rising over steel train tracks, red flashing crossing signals, lowering striped wooden gate arms, steel freight train approaching on the right track, open desert road beyond.
clanging railroad crossing bell, freight train horn and rumbling V8 engine
CROSSING_BEYOND: Open desert road just past the railroad crossing at dusk: wide dirt shoulder, steaming muscle car resting upright on the shoulder, orange sport coupe stopped nearby, long straight road stretching toward the glowing horizon.
ticking hot metal, distant approaching sirens and desert wind

scenes.title: Đêm Đen Xa Lộ 10
scenes.purpose: Verni điều khiển xe container 18 bánh chở hàng điện tử giữa đêm thì ba chiếc Civic đen đèn gầm xanh lá áp sát.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Ai đang điều khiển ba chiếc xe đen vây quanh đầu kéo trên xa lộ?
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Ba vệt đèn neon xanh lá xé màn đêm khóa chặt ba phía xe tải.
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Verni phát hiện đội hình vây ép qua gương chiếu hậu và tăng cảnh giác.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Mở màn phi phi vụ lấy hàng container tốc độ cao và giới thiệu tài xế Verni.

scenes.outgoing_audio: Carry the deep diesel rig rumble, high-rpm tuned exhausts and highway wind across the cut into the next scene without quiet pause.

clips.start_frame: In HIGHWAY_NIGHT during N1 night (shot 01.1 opening): Verni seated inside the elevated left-hand driver seat of the moving 18-wheel semi-truck cab (RIG_18) cruising eastbound at 110 km/h, hands steady on the 18-inch steering wheel while emerald-green underglow from three matte-black coupes (CIVIC_TRIO) appears in the wide side mirrors.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.0s): Verni glances sharply into the wide right west-coast mirror as three matte-black Civic coupes with emerald-green underglow surge up the highway lanes behind the trailer. Beat 2 (4.0–7.9s): Verni downshifts the floor gear lever with his right hand to hold center-lane momentum while speaking aloud inside the vibrating diesel cab. Beat 3 (7.9–10.0s): Verni locks both hands on the steering wheel rim at ten-and-two, eyes narrowing on the right mirror as the lead black coupe pulls beside the cab steps.
clips.end_frame: In HIGHWAY_NIGHT at 10.0s of shot 01.1: Verni seated in the left-hand driver seat of the moving RIG_18 cab with both hands locked on the wheel and green underglow reflecting across the right cab glass.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Verni, tài xế xe đầu kéo đường dài trên xa lộ mười.

dialogue.speaker: VERNI
dialogue.text: Giờ này mà ba chiếc xe đen tắt pha bám đuôi là có biến rồi.

clips.lighting: Crisp nocturnal street lighting: sodium vapour and neon highlights cutting through deep asphalt shadows, natural skin tones, restrained contrast.

cinematic.intent: Verni điều khiển xe container 18 bánh chở hàng điện tử giữa đêm thì ba chiếc Civic đen đèn gầm xanh lá áp sát. (Shot 01.1 — ESTABLISHING_WIDE via wide establishing 24mm lens).
cinematic.composition: Using a wide establishing 24mm low-angle exterior pursuit tracking camera rig at wheel-and-fender height, frame Verni with the 18-Wheel Charcoal Semi-Truck & Silver Trailer inside HIGHWAY_NIGHT, surrounded by concrete center jersey barrier, dashed white lane markings, raised amber cats-eye reflector studs, steel roadside guardrails.
cinematic.blocking: Preserve left-to-right 180-degree spatial continuity inside HIGHWAY_NIGHT; Verni holds the primary plane with smooth natural body follow-through. All moving vehicles travel in the exact same left-to-right forward direction along the road lane with rapidly spinning wheels and matched forward velocity; never face head-on or reverse axis.
cinematic.performance: Verni delivers the line with hardened long-haul grit, braced forearm tension on the wheel, resolute eyes, and booming gravelly projection and organic micro-expressions.
cinematic.focus: Keep tack-sharp focus on Verni's eyes, lip-sync articulation, and hand-and-body follow-through with the 18-Wheel Charcoal Semi-Truck & Silver Trailer, keeping low silhouetted Mojave foothills against a moonlit night sky, no readable highway signs readable in the background depth.
cinematic.texture: Coarse night-cooled highway asphalt, brushed aluminum trailer panels, matte-black coupe paintwork, emerald-green LED underglow reflections on pavement, and natural skin pores.
cinematic.sound_detail: HIGH-PRIORITY AUTOMOTIVE SFX: deep turbo-diesel 18-wheeler engine roar, heavy 18-tire highway tread hum, transmission gear engagement, and pneumatic air-brake hiss; high-revving twin-cam 4-cylinder exhaust note, turbocharger spool and wastegate flutter, crisp gearshifts, and high-speed spinning tire-on-asphalt traction roar, high-speed spinning tire-on-asphalt traction, crisp gearshifts, and wind slipstream layered prominently with Verni's Southern Vietnamese dialogue.
cinematic.rhythm: Continuous fluid tracking momentum from 0.0s, smooth spatial progression across 4.0–7.9s while dialogue plays in motion, and unbroken forward follow-through to 10.0s.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Nhân vật trong cảnh: Verni (VERNI). Đạo cụ & vật thể xung quanh: RIG_18, CIVIC_TRIO (concrete center jersey barrier, dashed white lane markings, raised amber cats-eye reflector studs, steel roadside guardrails). Giữ nguyên trang phục và vị trí đạo cụ xuyên suốt cú máy 01.1.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Đêm Đen Xa Lộ 10 (N1 night) · Góc máy E (ESTABLISHING_WIDE — wide establishing 24mm) · Mở hình tại 0.0s với Verni giữa concrete center jersey barrier, dashed white lane markings, raised amber cats-eye reflector studs, steel roadside guardrails trong không gian HIGHWAY_NIGHT.
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–4.0s): Verni glances sharply into the wide right west-coast mirror as three matte-black Civic coupes with emerald-green underglow surge up the highway lanes behind the trailer. Nhịp 2 (4.0–7.9s): Verni downshifts the floor gear lever with his right hand to hold center-lane momentum while speaking aloud inside the vibrating diesel cab — Thoại (Verni): "Giờ này mà ba chiếc xe đen tắt pha bám đuôi là có biến rồi.". Nhịp 3 (7.9–10.0s): Verni locks both hands on the steering wheel rim at ten-and-two, eyes narrowing on the right mirror as the lead black coupe pulls beside the cab steps.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế của Verni cùng các vật thể xung quanh (RIG_18, CIVIC_TRIO) tại giây 10.0s, tuyệt đối không nháy ảnh thẻ tham chiếu.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy E (ESTABLISHING_WIDE · wide establishing 24mm) · Chuyển cảnh OPEN · Vật thể xung quanh: concrete center jersey barrier, dashed white lane markings, raised amber cats-eye reflector studs, steel roadside guardrails.

clips.avoid: changing vehicle color, wheel count or left-hand driver side, stationary or non-spinning wheels on moving vehicles, vehicles driving or facing in opposite directions during a race or pursuit, muted engine or tire sound effects, adding duplicate characters or broadcaster logos

clips.start_frame: In HIGHWAY_NIGHT during N1 night (shot 01.2 opening): Verni seated in the left-hand driver seat of the moving RIG_18 cab at 110 km/h with green underglow from the lead matte-black Civic coupe reflecting across the right passenger glass.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.8s): Verni leans slightly toward the right cab window to track the lead matte-black coupe pacing his front bumper while a second black coupe boxes in the left lane. Beat 2 (2.8–7.1s): Verni presses his boot firmer on the throttle pedal and calls out over the diesel roar as the three coupes lock formation around the rig. Beat 3 (7.1–10.0s): Verni steadies the heavy steering wheel against the slipstream buffet, jaw set under the amber dash light.
clips.end_frame: In HIGHWAY_NIGHT at 10.0s of shot 01.2: Verni seated in the left-hand driver seat of RIG_18 gripping the wheel as the three matte-black coupes hold tight three-side formation outside the cab glass.

dramaturgy.hook_vi: Tom bước vào phòng tác chiến đầy bản đồ xa lộ với vệt bụi trên gò má.
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Nese nhìn vệt bụi trên má Sĩ quan Tom và hỏi xoáy về cuộc đụng độ vừa xảy ra.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Lật mở thân phận cảnh sát chìm LAPD của Tom và giới thiệu Nese cùng Kinan.

dramaturgy.turn_vi: Seja lau bóng nắp capô chiếc Jetta trắng tâm huyết trong khi Tom và Ami đứng bên cạnh khích lệ.
